expectations.text: Adapts both concretely to a vintage-furniture pop-up
expectations.evidence: Concrete translations: '$25 ticket, fully credited toward any purchase', 'The 5 Tells of Real Vintage' replacing Seven Pillars, 'Spot the Reproduction' station, '14-Day Room Refresh Challenge', 'Vintage 101' talks at cafés/breweries, 'Win a restored mid-century side table' lead box, upholsterer/florist raffle prizes, stock-planning note on one-of-a-kind inventory.

Section 8 week -8 to after-closing timeline; three drafted invite emails at ~21/10/3 days out, reminders at 2 days/morning/1 hour; Section 6 ads, retargeting, giveaway; Section 7 non-buyer follow-up within 7 days, NPS/review asks (no gating), waitlist for next pop-up.

Ticket price $25 (test vs $45), 60 tickets, 85% show -> ~51 attendees, ~18 buyers at 35%, AOV $420 -> ~$7,500, cost per ticket under ~$40 (derived from Hormozi's spend-per-show logic), 400+ contacts, workshop math 6 weeks × 2–3 × ~12 people ≈ 180 reached.
